answer: Latency-Bucket Admission Control: each identity must sustain a Poisson arrival pattern whose inter-request gaps fit an enforced entropy band over a rolling window; bursty or perfectly periodic traffic fails. A voyage of probes must be spread across distinct time buckets. A quill signs each bucket's timing trace, and only traces yielding sufficient nectar of variance admit the agent. Attackers must run real-time, jittered scheduling per identity, paying infrastructure and wall-clock delay per sybil.
